preconditions.description: The size of the permutation K must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: len(P) == K and all(1 <= x <= K for x in P)
preconditions.description: The permutation P must contain exactly K elements, each between 1 and K.

preconditions.expression: len(matrix) == K and all(len(row) == K and all(c in 'YN' for c in row) for row in matrix)
preconditions.description: The matrix must be a KxK matrix with each element being either 'Y' or 'N'.

postconditions.description: The output must be the lexicographically smallest permutation of P.
